scope: Current connected filament drybox: one entry per current printed part, its owning source and latest print state. cad/drybox.py builds and checks every part from these sources. Bottom-side desiccant baskets are not designed. The container is unmeasured (nominal 2 mm wall assumed), so outlet placement on it and the anchor and upper-frame fit are not modeled.
